why: I checked each verifier check's PASS and FAIL conditions against the words of its expect line. Check 1 tests that clamp is exported and returns lo, hi or x. The inclusive-bound and "lo==hi" cases follow from "limited to the range lo to hi". Check 2 requires only that each call with lo > hi throws "an instance of RangeError". Check 3 asks that each exported function is named in README.md and that the README "says what each listed function does". That is what "documents every function" requires. It does not demand a particular heading format, which appears only in the builder brief. Check 4 needs a 0 exit status and no failing or cancelled tests. Under `node --test`, cancelled tests already make the run exit non-zero, so this adds no extra requirement. The stricter items are listed under "Advisory (not part of any PASS or FAIL condition)": clamp tests being added, the file scope, and NaN behaviour.
